digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center backend transport adapter / TicketTransport protocol
propositions: JiraDataCenterTransport lacks twelve methods the reconciler core invokes, causing a writing pass to crash on the first missing method encountered (set_entity_property) while silently failing to sync via the remaining eleven when exception handlers swallow AttributeError.

Seven of the twelve absent members have call sites that catch and discard all exceptions at every site, producing silent degradation (comments, links, parents, properties, assignee validation lost) rather than visible errors, making 'no AttributeError' an insufficient acceptance criterion.

TicketTransport protocol lacks @runtime_checkable decorator and does not declare the twenty-one members the core actually requires, so isinstance conformance checks fail with TypeError and cannot guard against missing members at transport construction time.

The port describes forty percent of its requirement—six members declared, twenty-one members called—which is why conformance tests and unit suite both pass green against a transport that cannot complete a writing pass.

Reporter mutations re-emit on every DC pass because inbound_fields._identity_of reads only accountId (which DC lacks) and not the name field, causing the differ to perpetually compare None against the resolved username, breaking idempotence even after a successful write.

Three of the twelve methods require triage rather than bulk translation: get_parent_map must use DC REST v2 offset paging (not Cloud's v3 cursor), set_reporter needs DC's name identity field and a _identity_of fix, and set_parent must branch on epic vs sub-task parent types with agile_rest_path configured for greenhopper.
